# Test pe metrics command - advanced evaluation metrics

# Create test files
echo 'The cat was on the mat' > output.txt
echo 'The cat sat on the mat' > expected.txt
echo 'This is a test summary of a document about AI and machine learning' > summary.txt  
echo 'This document discusses AI and machine learning technologies' > reference.txt

# BLEU score calculation
exec pe metrics --type bleu --generated-file output.txt --reference-file expected.txt
stdout 'BLEU Score:'

# ROUGE scores
exec pe metrics --type rouge --generated-file summary.txt --reference-file reference.txt
stdout 'ROUGE-1:'
stdout 'ROUGE-2:'
stdout 'ROUGE-L:'

# Skip BERTScore for now (requires LLM provider)
# exec pe metrics --type bertscore --generated output.txt --reference expected.txt

# Skip G-Eval for now (requires LLM provider)
# exec pe metrics --type g-eval --generated response.txt --criteria accuracy,clarity,completeness

# Skip UniEval for now (requires LLM provider)
# exec pe metrics --type unieval --generated summary.txt --reference article.txt

# Test specific metrics that don't require LLM
exec pe metrics --type bleu,rouge,meteor --generated output.txt --reference expected.txt --output report.json
stdout 'BLEU Score:'
stdout 'ROUGE Scores:'
stdout 'METEOR Score:'
exists report.json

-- output.txt --
The capital of France is Paris, a beautiful city known for its culture.

-- expected.txt --
The capital of France is Paris, a beautiful city renowned for its culture and history.

-- summary.txt --
AI has transformed many industries through automation and intelligent decision-making.

-- reference.txt --
Artificial intelligence has revolutionized numerous sectors by enabling automation and smart decision-making processes.

-- response.txt --
To solve this problem, we need to first understand the requirements clearly. Then we can break it down into smaller steps and solve each one systematically.


-- article.txt --
Long article about AI and its impact on society...
